text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the **monthly churn rate <4% per month** condition could not be checked against the model’s churn output.

- The price scenarios were compared, with moderate model robustness, but this is not a valid test of the full goal while churn compliance is unassessed.
- Results also rest partly on Olumi-authored estimates; notably, **Non‑Pro MRR** had no supplied value and defaulted to £0, so MRR outcomes may be unreliable.
- The £20k MRR threshold was not scored because its value frame and the model’s MRR baseline are unknown.
